theorem sum_real_supported_progression_divisor_weights_le_lcm
    (S : Finset ℕ) {a b : ℝ} {D q : ℕ} {r : ℤ} (w : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hS : ∀ n ∈ S, a ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ b)
    (hmod : ∀ n ∈ S, Int.ModEq (q : ℤ) (n : ℤ) r)
    (hw : ∀ d ∈ Icc 1 D, 0 ≤ w d) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, ∑ d ∈ (Icc 1 D).filter (fun d => d ∣ n), w d) ≤
      ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 D, w d * ((b - a) / (Nat.lcm d q : ℝ) + 1) := by

theorem sum_fouvryTau_real_progression_floor_lcm_payment
    (S : Finset ℕ) {K q : ℕ} {r : ℤ} (hK : 2 ≤ K) (hq : 0 < q)
    {a b Z : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hZ : 2 ≤ Z) (hbZ : b ≤ Z)
    (hS : ∀ n ∈ S, a ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ b)
    (hmod : ∀ n ∈ S, Int.ModEq (q : ℤ) (n : ℤ) r) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, (fouvryTau K n : ℝ)) ≤
      (K : ℝ) * ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 ⌊realDeletionRadius K Z⌋₊,
        (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ) * ((b - a) / (Nat.lcm d q : ℝ) + 1) := by

theorem card_real_supported_modEq_dvd_le_lcm (S : Finset ℕ) {a b : ℝ}

    (hS : ∀ n ∈ S, a ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ b)
    (hmod : ∀ n ∈ S, Int.ModEq (q : ℤ) (n : ℤ) r)
    (hdiv : ∀ n ∈ S, d ∣ n) :
    (S.card : ℝ) ≤ (b - a) / (Nat.lcm d q : ℝ) + 1 := by
  classical
  by_cases hne : S.Nonempty

theorem sum_real_supported_divisor_weights_swap (S : Finset ℕ) (D : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, ∑ d ∈ (Icc 1 D).filter (fun d => d ∣ n), w d) =
      ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 D, w d * ((S.filter (fun n => d ∣ n)).card : ℝ) := by
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d _hd
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

theorem sum_fouvryTau_real_support_floor_payment (S : Finset ℕ) {K : ℕ}
    (hK : 2 ≤ K) {a b Z : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hZ : 2 ≤ Z) (hbZ : b ≤ Z)
    (hS : ∀ n ∈ S, a ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ b) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, (fouvryTau K n : ℝ)) ≤
      (K : ℝ) * ((b - a) *
        (∑ d ∈ Icc 1 ⌊realDeletionRadius K Z⌋₊,
          (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) +
        ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 ⌊realDeletionRadius K Z⌋₊, (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ)) := by

theorem fouvryTau_le_truncated_divisor_sum_strict {K n D : ℕ}

      (∑ d ∈ n.divisors.filter (fun d => d ≤ D), fouvryTau (K - 1) d) := by

def realDeletionRadius (K : ℕ) (Z : ℝ) : ℝ := Z ^ (((K - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (K : ℝ))

theorem floor_radius_strict_cutoff {K B : ℕ} (hK : 2 ≤ K) {Z : ℝ}
    (hZ : 1 ≤ Z) (hBZ : (B : ℝ) ≤ Z) :
    B ^ (K - 1) < (⌊realDeletionRadius K Z⌋₊ + 1) ^ K := by
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ realDeletionRadius K Z := le_trans zero_le_one (realDeletionRadius_bounds hK hZ).1
  have hlt : realDeletionRadius K Z ^ K <

theorem native_floor_tau_payment {K : ℕ} (hK : 2 ≤ K) {R Z Y : ℝ}
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hRZ : R ≤ Z) (hY : 0 ≤ Y) :
    Y * (∑ d ∈ Icc 1 ⌊R⌋₊, (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) +
        (∑ d ∈ Icc 1 ⌊R⌋₊, (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ)) ≤
      Y * (1 + Real.log Z) ^ (K - 1) + R * (1 + Real.log Z) ^ (K - 2) := by
  have hI : Icc 1 ⌊R⌋₊ = Ioc 0 ⌊R⌋₊ := by
    ext d

theorem truncated_divisor_carrier_eq {n D : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    n.divisors.filter (fun d => d ≤ D) = (Icc 1 D).filter (fun d => d ∣ n) := by
  ext d
def fouvryTau (k : ℕ) : ArithmeticFunction ℕ := ArithmeticFunction.zeta ^ k

theorem fouvryTau_mul_le (k l n : ℕ) :
    fouvryTau k n * fouvryTau l n ≤ fouvryTau (k * l) n := by

theorem sum_fouvryTau_div_le_real (k : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (fouvryTau k n : ℝ) / n) ≤ (1 + Real.log x) ^ k := by
  have heq : reciprocalSum ⌊x⌋₊ = (harmonic ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) := by

theorem sum_fouvryTau_le_real {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (fouvryTau k n : ℝ)) ≤
      x * (1 + Real.log x) ^ (k - 1) := by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : k ≠ 0)

complete_source_argument: For each d in Icc1D, use the actual fiber S.filter(d|n). Its real support and arbitrary Int.ModEq q n r are inherited by membership projection; divisibility is the filter predicate. Positive d follows from the original Icc1D gate.

Invoke exactly the future CRTSpacing theorem on that fiber, with hab,hq,hd. It yields card(fiber)<=Y/lcm(d,q)+1 without a coprimality assumption, CRT representative, compatible-class premise or restriction on r.

The accepted RealEndpoint exact finite exchange sum_real_supported_divisor_weights_swap turns the literal double divisor sum into sum_d w(d)*card(fiber). Multiply each CRT inequality by the assumed nonnegative w(d), then sum. This proves the first reusable generic weighted payment.
For the actual d_K sum, the original real support gives n>=a>=1 and n<=b<=Z. Existing floor_radius_strict_cutoff supplies n^(K-1)<(floor(realDeletionRadius K Z)+1)^K.

Apply exactly the accepted StrictFloor fouvryTau_le_truncated_divisor_sum_strict. The existing Interval truncated_divisor_carrier_eq identifies its actual divisor filter with Icc1D filtered by d|n. exact_mod_cast yields the real pointwise d_K bound.

Sum these pointwise inequalities, pull out the exact K through Finset.mul_sum, and invoke the first generic weighted payment with w(d)=(fouvryTau(K-1)d:Real), nonnegative by Nat.cast_nonneg. This proves the full displayed arbitrary-r finite d_K lcm budget.

No closed arithmetic mean, shifted mixed moment or target-shaped estimate is used as a premise. The coefficient K is exact and fixed before all interval/modulus/residue choices; arbitrary negative/nonprimitive/incompatible r classes and empty/singleton/zero-length supported sets are allowed.
